Definition: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
BiblicalUsage: Magen is the shield, the buckler, and it is one of the Bible's pictures of God Himself. Genesis 15:1 has God telling Abram, I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward, and Psalms 3:3 says thou, O LORD, art a shield for me, my glory, and the lifter up of mine head. Proverbs 30:5 says God is a shield unto them that put their trust in Him, and Psalms 84:11 says the LORD God is a sun and shield who will withhold no good thing from them that walk uprightly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the shield in these verses is not a thing but a Person: God does not only give protection, He is the protection. My position is that Psalms 84:11 says it best, because a sun and a shield together mean light to walk by and cover to hide under, and both come from the same LORD.
